1️⃣ What is HMPV?
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus causing symptoms akin to the common cold, such as cough, runny nose, and sore throat. While often mild, it can lead to severe illness in young children, older adults and individuals with weakened immune systems. https://t.co/423tFeDGvZ

nodes.text:
2️⃣ Recent Outbreaks
Recent reports indicate a surge in HMPV cases in China, particularly with children's hospitals in Hunan province, experiencing overwhelming numbers of patients.
This situation has drawn parallels to previous viral outbreaks, raising global health concerns. https://t.co/QiM3ZjRwjV

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
3️⃣ Transmission
HMPV spreads through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes, similar to other respiratory viruses like RSV.
It can also spread by touching surfaces contaminated with the virus and then touching the face. https://t.co/hl1VIMZDsv

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
4️⃣ Symptoms
Common symptoms include:
🟡Cough
🟡Runny nose
🟡Sore throat
🟡Fever In severe cases,

It can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia, especially in vulnerable populations.

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
5️⃣ Prevention

Preventive measures include:
🟡Regular hand washing
🟡Avoiding close contact with infected individuals
🟡 Disinfecting frequently touched surfaces 
Currently, there is no vaccine for HMPV. https://t.co/W9t3moV2RB

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
6️⃣ Treatment

Treatment focuses on relieving symptoms:
🟡Staying hydrated
🟡Rest

Over-the-counter medications for fever and pain In severe cases, especially for those with underlying health conditions, medical attention may be necessary.

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
7️⃣ Global Health Implications

Recent surge in HMPV cases underscores the need for vigilance in monitoring respiratory viruses. While HMPV is not new, increased awareness & preventive measures are crucial to mitigate its impact, especially among high-risk groups.

Stay informed. https://t.co/cvjtLnohrM
